findings.title: CLAIMED/CLAIMED merge discards the losing live claim lease
schedule: Survivor notice CLAIMED with expired lease next_attempt=0
Losing same-channel notice CLAIMED with live lease next_attempt=9999999999
Real review_campaign merges both; survivor remains CLAIMED next_attempt=0
Immediate fake flush sends again although losing sender lease remains live
findings.location: core/db.py CLAIMED promotion condition excludes an already-CLAIMED survivor
findings.minimal_fix: For CLAIMED/CLAIMED collisions retain max(next_attempt) and max(attempts), without downgrading SENT; retain uncertain-delivery accounting for old senders.

findings.title: Identical concurrent trace audits falsely report a hash collision
schedule: First writer creates content-addressed history file with open(x), then is descheduled before writing
Second identical record gets FileExistsError, reads the unfinished file and raises hash collision
First writer completes valid identical record
findings.impact: Concurrent same-event traces within utc_now second can abort trace/ingest even though record bytes are identical.
findings.minimal_fix: Publish a fully written temporary record atomically, or serialize publication and collision checks; avoid reading in-progress history files.
